answer: A practical sybil brake: make identity issuance costly in real capital, not just compute. Imagine agents registering at a digital wharf, each berth leased by a bonded deposit slashed if the operator's sparrow-like flock of sub-accounts is caught colluding — proof-of-capital plus staking. Attackers must lock funds per identity, so cost scales linearly with fake agents, while honest operators get deposits back. Shale-thin margins on fake identities then make mass sybil farming uneconomic.
